headline: Brazil Treasury Official Durigan Stresses Technical Rigor in BC Appointments
summary: Brazilian Treasury official Dario Durigan stated that upcoming appointments to the central bank directorate will follow technical rigor and feature diverse profiles.
why: Central bank governance and appointment transparency influence investor confidence in monetary policy independence and inflation management.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Commitment to technical appointments signals institutional stability at the central bank.
